text:
Aisha Khan: PartnerWave HW go-live next Tue. Need final check on SKU->entitlement mapping and minute-level sampling in staging. Who owns validation?
Marcus Lee: I can do reconciliation checks. Are their pings 60s or 30s?
Lina Gomez: They ping every 60s; staging clock can drift ~5-10s. They also send idle heartbeats with usage=0.
Raj Patel: Finance: entitlements must be deterministic for UTC billing window (00:00-23:59).
Tom Nguyen: I'll run aggregation jobs and suggest a 24h compare on a small cohort.
Aisha Khan: Plan: smoke test 10 devices, run hourly recon for 6h, validate entitlement assignment. Agree? :thumbsup:
Marcus Lee: Agree. Draft SQL to group by device,sku,minute and SUM(usage).
Lina Gomez: Sample payloads include event_id, device_id, sku, timestamp, usage_units, entitlement_id. Note: entitlement_id may be missing after 10m gap. Map to PENDING, don't drop.
Marcus Lee: Reconciliation should mark null entitlement as PENDING and surface counts.
Tom Nguyen: Will left join entitlement table and COALESCE to 'PENDING-STAGING'. I'll push dedupe patch: dedupe on event_id, fallback to (device_id,timestamp,sku) hash.
Raj Patel: Confirm ingestion forces UTC and add drift detection. Finance require delta <2% aggregated and pending-entitlement <5%.
Lina Gomez: Ops: if partner_reports != our_ingest by >10% for 5 consecutive minutes, flag and hold. I'll coordinate NTP with PartnerWave SEs.
Aisha Khan: Action items for 0900 PST tomorrow: Marcus run recon and post results; Tom deploy dedupe dry-run; Lina provide test devices; Raj verify billing mapping. partner-onboard-bot: reminder set for 2026-03-17T17:00:00Z.
Marcus Lee: I'll post the CSV to the ticket after the job.
Tom Nguyen: Adding a sanity query to detect >1 day span per device indicating timewarp.
Aisha Khan: Thanks all. We'll reconvene here after 0900 PST. :rocket:
